source.title: Wikipedia: Blowpipe (tool)
source.gives: Blowpipe in mineral analysis since about 1738 (Bergman's account); Swab first; Cronstedt translated 1770; Bergman De Tubo Ferruminatorio 1779 (English 1788); Gahn's portable pipe; Lavoisier blew oxygen through one 1782; jewellers' mouth blowpipe since antiquity
